summary.en: Editing an income source's pay schedule (its pay date and how early a deposit still counts as on-time) now versions it: past periods keep reading the schedule that was actually in force instead of being retroactively rewritten. This is the backend half of the work only — no client surfaces schedule editing yet.
Bank-feed income matching now matches an early-arriving deposit against the pay schedule version that was actually in force on its date, instead of always using the current one.
